name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Desk Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality 3mm acrylic, lightweight yet durable, with a smooth surface and vibrant color display.
    - Comes with an acrylic base (5mm thick) to ensure stable display on desks or flat surfaces.
    - Includes 2 metal hinged ring clasps for secure hanging and easy photo or plate replacement.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    -  Available in multiple sizes:
           +) Overall frame size: 7×7 in ~ 17.78 × 17.78 cm with Acrylic base 7×7 in ~ 17.78 × 17.78 cm
           +) Overall frame size: 8×8 in ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm with Acrylic base 8×8 in ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
           +) Overall frame size: 10×10 in ~ 25.4 × 25.4 cm with Acrylic base 10×10 in ~ 25.4 × 25.4 cm
           +) Overall frame size: 12×12 in ~ 30.48 × 30.48 cm with Acrylic base 12×12 in ~ 30.48 × 30.48 cm
    - Metal ring clasp diameter: approx. 0.78 inches ~ 2 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Easy Assembly: Requires simple self-assembly by attaching the metal hinged ring clasps to the pre-drilled holes. Easy to assemble by hand—no tools or glue needed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using high-quality UV printing technology for clear, vibrant, and long-lasting colors.
    - Features double-sided printing on the frame, plate, and base for a complete and polished look.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as an acrylic desk sign with a hanging plate, creating a unique display.
    - Ideal for placement on desks, shelves, office tables, nightstands, or display cabinets.
    - The hanging plate design allows easy customization and replacement.
    - Functions as both a personalized keepsake and a stylish home or office décor piece.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and personalized gift for moms, dads, couples, friends, and family members.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, housewarmings, and special moments.
    - A timeless wooden keepsake that adds warmth and meaning to any space.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Desk Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
